# Sprout Social

> Sprout Social is a comprehensive social media management platform trusted by 30k+ brands to schedule content, engage audiences, analyze performance, and discover influencers across all major social networks.

Sprout Social provides an integrated suite of tools for social media professionals including AI-powered engagement, multi-channel publishing, advanced analytics, social listening, and influencer marketing capabilities. The platform serves enterprises, agencies, and mid-market teams across offices in Chicago, Seattle, Dublin, and Poland.

## Key Topics

- Social Media Management
- AI Assist
- Content Scheduling
- Social Listening
- Analytics & Reporting
- Influencer Marketing
- Employee Advocacy
- Multi-platform Publishing
- Sentiment Analysis
- Campaign Management
- Enterprise Solutions
- Agency Management
- Sprout AI
- NewsWhip
- ROI Measurement
